user.description: Enter the API user of your VoipCenter (PBXonline) account (created under API users in the admin interface).

websocket.title: Realtime call info
websocket.description: Optionally connect to the VoipCenter websocket to receive call notifications instantly. The username and key are pre-filled from the first websocket user ("Websockets" module in the "Config" menu). Leave the username empty to skip.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: The API password for {username} was rejected. Enter a new one.

reauth_api_user.title: Upgrade to APIv2
reauth_api_user.description: Version 2 of this integration uses the VoipCenter APIv2. Enter the API user to use for {title} (created under API users in the admin interface).

init.title: Realtime call info
init.description: Websocket settings for realtime call notifications. Leave the username empty to disable.

multiple_config_entries.message: Multiple VoipCenter accounts are loaded; specify config_entry_id.

start_call.name: Start call
